column3: BootUI 2.4.0 FailOn exits 3 on a counted finding; sharpit leaves the exit status to pytest and exits 1 (AGENTS.md: pytest owns the exit code)
sharpit's own: session, app and worker statuses merge worst first, FAILED, UNKNOWN, SKIPPED, PARTIAL, PASSED, and one warning per partial app; BootUI has one scan
BootUI reports a rule that throws as a PARTIAL scan; sharpit keeps the advisor UNKNOWN because the rule that errored may be the one that finds the problem (the REST API report still says PARTIAL)
An advisor that is not usable and lists no limitation is unchanged (PASSED when coverage is complete); BootUI treats zero usable evidence as unevaluable

Only an opaque mounted app makes an advisor PARTIAL; an unread router, exception handler or route is sharpit failing to assess (safety model 5) and stays UNKNOWN; BootUI lists every limitation as PARTIAL
